einzeiler: Paco Arias cooks lasagna with Oscar Alván while talking about rituals and dark times.
kurzfassung: Paco Arias welcomes Oscar Alván to his vlog to cook a homemade lasagna together. Over food preparation, Oscar Alván speaks openly about his religious practices and experiences with spirits. In a deeply personal moment, he also opens up about a recent severe depressive crisis and why he decided to keep going.
stichpunkte: Paco Arias and Oscar Alván buy groceries at the supermarket to cook a lasagna.
Oscar Alván discusses his involvement in traditional cults and Santería.
He shares unsettling encounters with paranormal phenomena tied to his family.
A ritual in the Bravo neighborhood turned chaotic when a spiritual entity sparked a fire.
Oscar Alván describes the rare and intense experience of being ridden by a spirit.
He opens up about hitting rock bottom and experiencing a severe suicide attempt a week prior.
Support from his wife and daughter ultimately stopped him from taking his own life.
The episode concludes with the hosts tasting the finished lasagna and sharing food with the crew.

clips.hook: People might think we are a couple
clips.text: While walking through the supermarket aisles, the hosts joke about how shoppers might misinterpret their close and affectionate behavior as a romantic relationship.

clips.hook: A spirit threw trophies across the room
clips.text: Oscar Alván recounts how a deceased family member manifested displeasure by throwing his daughter's trophies and appearing near the laundry room window.

clips.hook: A ritual that caused an unexplained fire
clips.text: During a ceremony in the Bravo neighborhood, a spiritual entity became so enraged that it inexplicably ignited a fire and caused complete chaos.

clips.hook: I didn't have the courage to end my life
clips.text: Oscar Alván admits in detail that he recently reached a breaking point with severe depression, but ultimately could not bring himself to pull the trigger.

clips.hook: My partner accepted me with all my demons
clips.text: Reflecting on his darkest moments, Oscar Alván expresses immense gratitude that his wife chose to stay and support him despite his struggles and flaws.

beschreibung:
¿Qué pasa cuando juntas la cocina, el humor regio y secretos oscuros del más allá? En este episodio especial de Paco Arias Vlogs, me fui con El Muerto a preparar una lasaña… pero lo que empezó como una tarde de risas comprando ingredientes en el súper, terminó con revelaciones paranormales que nadie se esperaba.El Muerto soltó información bastante fuerte y experiencias que jamás había contado ante una cámara. Entre salsas, pasta y misterio, las cosas se pusieron intensas en la cocina.¡Ponte cómodo, prepara tu botana y acompáñanos en este crossover único! 🔥👻Sigue a Paco Arias & Podcast Extra Anormal:Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pacoarias.i...
